description: Savvly MCP helps financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents compare retirement alternatives, check eligibility, and model lump-sum, monthly-contribution, and full-retirement scenarios. These tools support the Savvly Longevity Benefit, an SEC-registered fund designed to combine market exposure with later-life longevity payouts.
